children: LG Electronics, promoter of LG Electronics India, will be offloading  2% stake in the company through a block deal worth up to ₹2,320.5 crore. The offer involves up to 1.358 crore shares at a floor price of ₹1,709.30 apiece, a discount of around 6% to the stock’s last closing price.

According to market buzz, Schaeffler AG, parent of Schaeffler India, plans to sell up to 6 per cent stake in the Indian company through a block deal worth ₹3,188 crore at a floor price of  ₹3,400 a share.

Tata Steel Ltd  is planning evaluating whether to restructure its proposed transactions with APL Apollo Tubes Ltd following growing investor concerns, less than 48 hours after announcing the sale of its tubes and colour-coated businesses to the company and the acquisition of its downstream businesses

SG Mart has postponed its planned board meeting to consider capital raising instruments. The corporate action was deferred explicitly due to the unavailability of board directors., the company said in a notice to the stock exchanges.  Investors must wait for a rescheduled notice to understand the timing and structure of any proposed equity dilution, the notice further added.

title: Stocks to watch, November 26: LG Electronics, Tata Steel, SG Mart, APL Apollo Tubes, Fino Payments, PNB, Lupin, Cryogenic OGS, Lotus Chocolates
